observation.command:
cd /workspace
echo "=== ALL info.yml files containing 'openstreetmap' ==="
find . -name "*.info.yml" -not -path "*/vendor/*" | xargs grep -ln "openstreetmap" 2>/dev/null
echo ""
echo "=== deps of every custom submodule ==="
for f in $(find profile/modules/custom -name "*.info.yml" | sort); do
  echo "--- $f"
  awk '/^dependencies:/{f=1;next} /^[a-z_]+:/{if(f)exit} f' "$f"
done
